From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Benchmark report lifecycle emails — approvals + UTM plan + segmentation (final sign-off)

Team —

We’re at the “lock it” stage for the benchmark report nurture sequence. Can you all review today so we can schedule in HubSpot by EOD Monday?

Docs:
- Lifecycle sequence v4 (copy + subject lines + CTAs): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lifecycle-seq-v4
- UTM plan v2 (naming + content variants): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1utm-plan-v2

Asks:
1) Soojin: copy approvals + any “do/don’t” edits for claims language.
2) Tyler: confirm UTMs align with attribution + campaign object in HubSpot.
3) Grace/Isabelle: segmentation + routing (who goes to SDR vs self-serve) and any suppressions we’re missing.
4) Camila: final thumbs-up on sequence + send timing.

Proposed sequence (current):
- Email #1 (Day 0): “Benchmark report is live” — primary CTA download report, secondary CTA try API
- Email #2 (Day 3): “Methodology: how we measure latency/$” — CTA read methodology appendix
- Email #3 (Day 7): “Region/model spotlight” — CTA view tables + book consult
- Email #4 (Day 14): “Cut inference cost without surprises” — CTA book consult (Dedicated/Private) + link to reproduce example

Flag anything that feels off for enterprise (data residency / claims) or for PLG (too salesy).

Thanks,
Ben

—
Ben Carter
Campaign Owner (Growth)
Redwood Inference

From: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Benchmark report lifecycle emails — approvals + UTM plan + segmentation (final sign-off)

Reviewed UTM plan v2 — looks good with a couple tweaks to keep our reporting clean:

- Please standardize:
  - utm_source = lifecycle
  - utm_medium = email
  - utm_campaign = benchmark_report_feb2025
  - utm_content = {email1_announcement | email2_methodology | email3_spotlight | email4_consult}

- For A/B subject tests, don’t encode variant in utm_campaign (otherwise we fragment). Use utm_term or utm_content suffix:
  - utm_content=email1_announcement_a / _b

- Confirmed we have HubSpot Campaign object created: “Benchmark Report Feb 2025”

One more: we should use the same base vanity URL everywhere and let the redirect append UTMs. E.g.
- https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar

If web team is already doing canonical + rel tags, we’re fine.

Tyler

—
Tyler Benson
Marketing Ops & Attribution
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 11:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Benchmark report lifecycle emails — approvals + UTM plan + segmentation (final sign-off)

Copy notes inline on v4 (commented), but top-line changes:

1) Replace “best latency/$” language anywhere it appears with “measured latency/$ under the methodology described” + link to methodology.
2) Add a one-sentence constraint in Email #1 + #3:
   - “Results reflect the workloads and settings in the report; your workload may differ (see methodology + reproduce steps).”
3) Email #4 subject line “Cut inference cost without surprises” is good. The body gets a bit salesy in paragraph 2 — I suggested a more engineering-forward framing.

Also: in Email #2, avoid saying “apples-to-apples across providers” (too absolute). Suggest: “controlled comparisons across regions and model families.”

If you accept those edits, I’m comfortable approving the copy from positioning/comms.

Soojin

—
Soojin Lee
Positioning & Launch Messaging
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 12:07 PM PST
Subject: Re: Benchmark report lifecycle emails — approvals + UTM plan + segmentation (final sign-off)

Segmentation proposal (so SDRs don’t get spammed + we keep PLG clean):

ENROLL (nurture eligible):
- Net-new signups in last 90 days
- Existing free users w/ API key created but < $200 usage
- Marketing leads with benchmark report download

SUPPRESS:
- Current paying customers (CS-owned)
- Any open opp stage >= Discovery (AE-owned)
- “Do not contact” + competitors (existing suppression)
- Anyone who booked a meeting in last 30 days (avoid weird experience)

Routing/CTA:
- Email #3 and #4 “Book a consult” should go to round-robin SDR calendar for SMB/MM
- Enterprise (company size 1k+ or known target accounts) should go to “Request Dedicated/Private consult” form -> AE/SE routing

Tyler/Ben: can we add hidden field from UTMs to differentiate “self-serve consult” vs “enterprise consult” downstream?

Grace

—
Grace O'Connor
SDR Inbound Motion Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 1:22 PM PST
Subject: Re: Benchmark report lifecycle emails — approvals + UTM plan + segmentation (final sign-off)

+1 to Grace’s suppressions.

Two sales-ops notes:

1) Make sure the “open opp” suppression includes stage = “Technical evaluation” (we have a bunch of these that are technically not tagged as Discovery).

2) For reporting: can we ensure the campaign membership is created on first click OR first open? Historically we’ve used “clicked” as the membership trigger to reduce noise, but leadership sometimes asks for “reached” vs “engaged.”

If we keep membership = clicked, let’s add a dashboard card for sends/opens separately.

Isabelle

—
Isabelle Laurent
Sales Ops & Pipeline Reporting
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Benchmark report lifecycle emails — approvals + UTM plan + segmentation (final sign-off)

All — thanks. Proposed decisions:

UTMs:
- Adopt Tyler’s standardization exactly.
- We’ll do subject A/B with utm_content suffix (_a/_b) only.

Segmentation:
- Adopt Grace’s enroll/suppress.
- Add suppression for open opp stage “Technical evaluation” (Isabelle).

Routing:
- We’ll create 2 CTAs where relevant:
  - “Try the API” (self-serve)
  - “Talk to an engineer” (enterprise form)

Campaign membership:
- Let’s keep membership = clicked (consistent with prior). Tyler: can you add send/open stats cards so Isabelle can report “reached vs engaged” without changing membership criteria?

Soojin: I’ll accept your copy edits today and post v5. Camila: once v5 is up, can you do final sponsor sign-off?

Also attaching a screenshot of the HubSpot lists I’m using right now — sanity check welcome.

Attachment: HubSpot_Lists_Segmentation_Screenshot.png

Ben

Subject: Re: Benchmark report lifecycle emails — approvals + UTM plan + segmentation (final sign-off)

Yep — I can add dashboard cards for:
- Total sent
- Delivered
- Opens (unique)
- Clicks (unique)
- CTR

Re: hidden fields — we can pass through:
- form_type=selfserve_consult vs enterprise_consult
- campaign=benchmark_report_feb2025
- utm_content

Also: if we use the vanity URL, I’ll configure the redirect rules to append UTMs at click time so we’re not hardcoding them into the email HTML (less room for errors if we change).

Tyler

Camila — v5 is live with Soojin’s edits incorporated:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lifecycle-seq-v4 (same link; updated inside)

Final sign-off checklist (proposed):
- [x] Copy approved (Soojin)
- [x] UTMs standardized + campaign object exists (Tyler)
- [x] Suppressions (customers + open opps + DNC) confirmed (Grace/Isabelle)

If you’re good, we’ll schedule:
- Email #1: launch day +2 hours

- Email #3: T+7 days
- Email #4: T+14 days

Ben
